about_the_game:
"WHEN A FISH MEETS A SHOTGUN, GRAVITY TREMBLES"

In Flipper on Recoil you’re a fish with legs, a shotgun, and zero respect for the laws of physics. Forget about normal jumps: here everything runs on recoil. Blast yourself across giant floating platforms with your trusty shotgun while trying not to turn into a pancake on the floor.

The levels are built so you can chain impossible shots, unexpected bounces, and routes only a legged fish would even attempt. Sometimes moving forward means flying in the wrong direction, but with just the right push, even mistakes can turn into shortcuts.

Welcome to the Riptide Championship, where speed and chaos are the only rules that matter.

The chaos ahead:

  • Jumping… and shotgun blasts

Yes, there’s a jump button, but that’s just the appetizer. The real deal is pulling the trigger: blast yourself forward, backward, downward, or diagonally, and rocket through the air like a projectile with legs. Combine both mechanics to improvise absurd trajectories and pull off moments that seem impossible—until you nail them.

  • Power-ups that twist the rules

Moving with recoil is only the beginning. Power-ups completely change the way you move: instant reloads, boosted recoil, zero-gravity phases that turn everything into an airborne circus of chaos. They’re the extra kick that transforms a tough level into a playground for madness.

  • Linear levels, but never boring

Each stage is handcrafted to keep the action flowing. There’s always a clear path to the goal, but curious players—or the ones with lightning reflexes—will find ways to break the rules, cut corners, and chain together shortcuts that weren’t exactly “intended.” That blend of order and chaos is the spirit of the championship.

  • A central hub as the perfect excuse

The Riptide Championship is nothing more than a narrative pretext to drop an armed fish into a festival of floating platforms. From the hub you can pick levels, track your progress, and feel like part of a surreal tournament where nobody really questions why things are the way they are.

  • Old-school progression

No endless menus, no overcomplicated systems. The rules are simple: beat a level, unlock the next, repeat until you conquer the championship. That straightforward structure lets you focus on what matters: moving fast, shooting with precision, and (hopefully) landing on your feet.

  • Local leaderboards for your pride

There are no online rankings here—the fight is more personal. Every stage records your best times so you can push yourself again and again, hunting for the fastest route or the most ridiculous chain of shots. Perfect for speedrunners, or for anyone who just wants to outdo their own disasters.

name: Flipper On Recoil

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 470 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 o AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: Flipper on Recoil is a fast-paced 3D platformer where a fish with legs and a shotgun takes on gravity. Use recoil, power-ups, and absurd tricks to blast through handcrafted levels and chase your best times.
